900.author: yuanzhou75
900.body:
## Summary

Registering a GLM (or other OpenAI-compatible) model with `apiVariant: "deepseek"` makes the runtime inject thinking-control parameters (`enable_thinking`, `reasoning`, `thinking.type`) into model requests. Some OpenAI-compatible gateways reject these with 400:

```
BadRequestError: Error code: 400 - {'error': {'message': 'Unsupported gateway parameters: enable_thinking, reasoning', 'type': 'model_gateway_error'}}
```

and separately, for the image-modality warmup probe:

```
BadRequestError: Error code: 400 - {'error': {'message': 'images are not supported by this gateway', 'type': 'model_gateway_error'}}
```

Main text/chat completions still succeed, but the housekeeping image probe fails on every start, leaving `image_input=unknown`.

## Reproduction

1. Register a model via `POST /api/models` with `apiProtocol: "openai-chat-completions"`, `apiVariant: "deepseek"`, and a GLM OpenAI-compatible `baseUrl`.
2. Start the stack and watch the JiuwenSwarm llm log for the image warmup probe ("What color is this image? Reply with one word.").

## Observed behaviour

- `llm_call_error … BadRequestError: 400 - Unsupported gateway parameters: enable_thinking, reasoning`
- `llm_call_error … images are not supported by this gateway`
- Warmup records `image_input=unknown (not cached)`.

## Expected behaviour

- Thinking-control params should only be injected for dialects/gateways that accept them, or a gateway rejection of those extra params should be tolerated rather than erroring the warmup.
- An "images not supported" rejection should be recorded cleanly as "image input not supported", not surfaced as a repeated 400 error.

## Environment

- ScienceDiscovery local stack on WSL2 (Ubuntu), JiuwenSwarm backend.
- Model: glm-5.3-flash, baseUrl `https://yibuapi.com/v1`, apiVariant `deepseek`.
- Main chat completion works (greeting + idea-tree runs succeeded); only the image probe is affected.
900.title: [Bug]: deepseek API variant sends enable_thinking/reasoning params that some OpenAI-compatible gateways reject
